signature.name: VTask.coprod
signature.type: {R : Type u} -> {M : Type v} -> {M₂ : Type w} -> {M₃ : Type y} -> [Semiring R] -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [AddCommMonoid M₂] -> [AddCommMonoid M₃] -> [Module R M] -> [Module R M₂] -> [Module R M₃] -> (f : M →ₗ[R] M₃) -> (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) -> M × M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.coprod is a total constructor with no junk-value edge conventions; it is well-defined for all linear maps f and g into a common codomain.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} {M₂ : Type*} {M₃ : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [AddCommMonoid M₃] [Module R M] [Module R M₂] [Module R M₃] (g : M₂ →ₗ[R] M₃) (x : M) (y : M₂), VTask.coprod (0 : M →ₗ[R] M₃) g (x, y) = g y
